## Purpose
A semantic diff between two workflow definitions: steps by id, edges as pairs, config by key, inputs by name. It is what a revision proposal shows the user.

## Responsibilities
- `_STEP_FIELDS` are type, tier, description and parallel_group.
- `_edges(definition)` returns the (from, to) pairs from next_steps and condition branches.
- `_short(value, 240)`.
- **`_step_changes(before, after)`** compares the fields, `next_steps` (sorted), and each config key.
- **`diff_definitions(before, after)`** returns:
  - steps_added, steps_removed and `steps_modified` `[{step_id, changes}]`;
  - edges_added and edges_removed;
  - entry_step `{before, after}` and description;
  - inputs `{added, removed, modified}`;
  - `changed`;
  - `stats {added, removed, modified, edges, inputs}`.

## Key elements
`diff_definitions`.

## Nuances and gotchas
A text diff of the JSON would bury a moved step under reordered keys.
